activemask-div.ptx: GPGPU-Sim: activemask in divergent code returns the whole warp (expected per-path masks 0xffff / 0xffff0000)
cvt-nan-int.ptx: GPGPU-Sim: float->int cvt of NaN / out-of-range values is a host C conversion (ISA 9.7.10.24: NaN -> 0, saturate to the range)
div-approx-range.ptx: GPGPU-Sim: div.approx.f32 is an exact host division (ISA 9.7.3.8: 2^126 < |b| < 2^128 gives 0 or NaN)
func-scope-vars.ptx: GPGPU-Sim: no nested-scope shadowing of registers / function-scope variables
scope.ptx: GPGPU-Sim: no nested-scope shadowing of registers
block.ptx: GPGPU-Sim (zluda/block.ptx): no nested-scope shadowing of registers
link-weak.ptx: GPGPU-Sim: the last .weak definition wins instead of the first; .visible does not replace .weak
ieee-diff.ptx: f32 NaN payloads only (sqrt of negative): Sail canonical 0x7fffffff, GPGPU-Sim 0x7fc00000; single-precision NaNs are unspecified (ISA 9.7.3)
rcp-approx-f64.ptx: GPGPU-Sim: rcp/rsqrt.approx.ftz.f64 computed in full precision on the host (ISA 9.7.3.13/16: 1.11.20 on a[63:32])
rounding-diff-f16.ptx: GPGPU-Sim: f16 arithmetic evaluated in f32 and rounded twice, rounding modifiers ignored
rounding-diff-f32.ptx: GPGPU-Sim: directed rounding of rcp/sqrt/div/cvt ignored (host round-to-nearest)
rounding-diff-f64.ptx: GPGPU-Sim: directed rounding of rcp.f64/sqrt.f64 ignored
sm1x-ftz.ptx: GPGPU-Sim: no sm_1x target semantics (implicit flush to zero)
sm1x-mad.ptx: GPGPU-Sim: no sm_1x mad.f32 (truncated product) semantics
testfloat.ptx: GPGPU-Sim: sqrt/fma not correctly rounded for all inputs, overflow under directed rounding
testfloat-rm.ptx: GPGPU-Sim: directed-rounding overflow returns NaN/inf instead of the largest finite value; sqrt/fma rounding
testfloat-rp.ptx: GPGPU-Sim: directed-rounding overflow returns NaN/inf instead of the largest finite value; sqrt/fma rounding
testfloat-rz.ptx: GPGPU-Sim: directed-rounding overflow returns NaN/inf instead of the largest finite value; sqrt/fma rounding
cvt_f16x2_f32.ptx: GPGPU-Sim: cvt.rn.f16x2.f32 d, a, b puts a in the low half and drops b (ISA: a -> d[31:16], b -> d[15:0])
fma_f16x2.ptx: GPGPU-Sim: fma.rn.f16x2 computes only the low half
selp.ptx: GPGPU-Sim: selp with an immediate predicate operand selects the wrong source
selp_true.ptx: GPGPU-Sim: selp with an immediate predicate operand selects the wrong source
shf_l_clamp.ptx: GPGPU-Sim: shf.clamp with a shift of 32 or more (C shift by 32)
shf_r_clamp.ptx: GPGPU-Sim: shf.clamp with a shift of 32 or more (C shift by 32)
sink.ptx: GPGPU-Sim: vector ld with sink (_) elements loads into the wrong registers
isa-ty-relaxed.ptx: GPGPU-Sim: ld.global.s8 into a 32-bit register zero-extends (ISA 9.4.1 Table 28: sign-extend)
vote_all_sub.ptx: GPGPU-Sim: vote.sync.all with a full membermask after lane 0 exited returns false (exited lanes do not take part)
